'''Acquos''' was an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xxan]], and it was situated within a large, [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] dome. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Trantos]] and a [[Plo Koon's Padawan|Jedi Padawan]] traveled to Acquos, to rendezvous with the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Zandoo]].
